## Context / Problem
Every uv-ecosystem Dependabot run fails (29 of 29 uv runs between 2026-10-07 and 2026-11-03; example run 41206250625, `tool_version_not_supported`, detected `==0.13.6`, supported `0.13.5`). Dependabot runs one bundled uv (dependabot-core `uv/Dockerfile`: `ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:0.13.5`). uv itself enforces `[tool.uv] required-version` (pyproject.toml:362, `==0.13.6`) and exits 2 on a mismatch, and dependabot-core `uv/lib/dependabot/uv/file_updater/lock_file_error_handler.rb` maps that to `tool_version_not_supported`. The same failure occurred with Dependabot AHEAD of the old `==0.12.7` pin (run 38642411336, supported 0.12.18), so any exact pin fails whenever the two versions differ. Upstream: dependabot-core #13199 (open). dependabot.yml has no tool-version key.

Operator decision (2026-11-03): unpin uv unless a compelling reason needs the exact version. Evidence gathered:
- Lock churn: none. On a scratch copy, uv 0.12.7 and uv 0.13.6 both pass `uv lock --check` and rewrite `uv.lock` (version 1, revision 5) byte-identically.
- Supply chain: the checksum-verified CI install (`.github/actions/setup-uv/action.yml`, committed `UV_SHA256_*`) needs ONE concrete version to download, but it does not need `required-version` to be exact. The version can live in the action next to the checksums it belongs to.
- Incidents: the pin's history (56b7-b21a-c8ab-4afc, 5caa-4b63-7ea2-4e71) fixed CI fetching a remote manifest. That needs CI to know a concrete version, which the action keeps. 2d87-7428-abcf-4bd9 and corking-phonolite-drafthorse are failures CAUSED by the exact pin (make venv refusing a newer host uv).
- Docs: no ADR or doc requires an exact uv pin for reproducible builds or SBOMs. `docs/local-dev-env.md` describes the pin but does not require it.
- Floor capability, verified by live run 2026-11-03 on a scratch copy with uv 0.13.6: `required-version = ">=0.12.7"` -> `uv lock --check` passes; `">=0.13.7"` -> uv refuses with "Required uv version `>=0.13.7` does not match the running version `0.13.6`". So uv accepts and enforces a PEP 440 floor.

## Approach
1. `pyproject.toml`: `required-version = ">=0.12.7"`. The floor is the oldest uv verified to write this `uv.lock` identically and pass `uv lock --check`, and the version all CI ran from 2026-08-28 to 2026-10-28. It contains Dependabot's 0.13.5 and the host's 0.13.6.
2. `.github/actions/setup-uv/action.yml`: read the version to install from a step env `UV_VERSION: 0.13.6` (beside the 6 checksums for that release) instead of parsing `==X.Y.Z` from pyproject. CI stays on an exact, checksum-verified, manifest-free release.
3. `scripts/check_uv_pin.py`: require `required-version` to be a single `>=X.Y.Z` floor (reject `==`, upper bounds, and missing). Add `REQUIRED_UV_VERSION = "0.13.6"` beside `REQUIRED_CHECKSUMS` (the release those checksums belong to) and require the action's `UV_VERSION` to equal it and satisfy the floor. Require each uv image tag to be exact and satisfy the floor, and drop the rule that the tag EQUAL `required-version`, since that equality only existed because uv refused any other version. The other rules stay: no `uv.toml`, no upstream setup-uv, no per-call version inputs, checksums, no `:latest`, and no ARG-templated uv tag.
4. Makefile `venv` preflight (Makefile:208-215): parse the floor from `required-version = ">=X.Y.Z"` and fail only when the selected uv is OLDER than it (compare with `sort -V`), printing "ERROR: selected uv is version <actual>, older than this repository's minimum <floor>." plus the path.
5. Docs: rewrite the `docs/local-dev-env.md` uv prerequisite section (any uv >= floor works; no exact local install needed). Update the `pyproject.toml` comment, the Makefile lint comment, and the 2 version mentions in `docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md`. Dockerfiles keep `ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:0.13.6` (exact tag, satisfies floor).

## Scope
In: the files in file_impact. Out: `~/.local/share/uv-pins` and host shell files (already removed by the operator); dependabot.yml; the `uv.lock` contents.

## Testing
TDD, failing first, no autouse fixtures. Every existing test the change touches is listed.

`tests/unit/test_worktree_python_pin.py`:
- Lines 31-33: `_PINNED_UV` uses an `==`-anchored regex with `.group(1)` and would raise at import. Replace it with `_UV_FLOOR`, parsed from `required-version = ">=X.Y.Z"`; `_sandbox`'s stub uv reports `_UV_FLOOR` by default, so the interpreter tests (`asks_for_the_pinned_interpreter`, `fails_loudly_rather_than_falling_back`) keep running unchanged.
- `test_make_venv_reports_uv_version_mismatch_before_python_hint` (lines 181-199): its stub 0.12.9 is ABOVE the new floor. Change the stub to 0.12.6 (below the floor) and assert the new message "ERROR: selected uv is version 0.12.6, older than this repository's minimum 0.12.7" plus the stub path; keep its no-`uv venv`, no-python-hint assertions.
- New `test_make_venv_accepts_uv_newer_than_the_floor`: stub 99.0.0, `make venv` exits 0 and calls `venv --python <pin>`.

`tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py`:
- Fixture `PYPROJECT_PINNED` -> `PYPROJECT_FLOOR` with `required-version = ">=0.13.0"`; `ACTION_CLEAN` gains step env `UV_VERSION: 0.13.6`. `test_fixture_baseline_passes` must still pass.
- `test_range_specifier_is_rejected` -> parametrize `"==0.13.6"`, `">=0.13.0,<0.14"`, `"~=0.13.0"`, `"0.13.6"`, `"<0.14"`; assert exit 1 and "floor" in stderr. `test_missing_pin_is_rejected` unchanged.
- New: action `UV_VERSION` missing -> rejected; `UV_VERSION: 0.12.9` (below floor) -> rejected; `UV_VERSION` not equal to the script's `REQUIRED_UV_VERSION` (the version its `REQUIRED_CHECKSUMS` belong to) -> rejected.
- `test_dockerfile_uv_tag_skewed_from_pyproject_is_rejected`: tag 0.12.9 is below the fixture floor 0.13.0; assert "0.12.9" and "0.13.0" in stderr. `..._skewed_tag_with_digest_is_still_rejected` and the compose case keep asserting "installs uv 0.12.9".
- New: Dockerfile tag `uv:0.13.9` (above floor, differs from the action) -> accepted.
- `test_dockerfile_uv_digest_without_a_tag_is_rejected` keeps its `uv:0.13.6@DIGEST` suggestion (taken from the action's `UV_VERSION`). The `:latest`, untagged, templated, and digest-with-tag tests are unchanged. `test_local_action_emits_acceptance_anchor` stays true because the action still prints `Successfully installed uv $version`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `pyproject.toml` has `required-version = ">=0.12.7"`.
- [x] `python scripts/check_uv_pin.py` exits 0 on the tree.
- [x] `pytest tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py tests/unit/test_worktree_python_pin.py` passes.
- [x] The new floor cases in those 2 files fail against the pre-change implementation (recorded in a ticket comment).
- [x] `uv lock --check` exits 0 under uv 0.13.6.
- [x] `make lint` exits 0.
- [x] `make typecheck` exits 0.
- [x] `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` exits 0.
- [x] `git grep -nF '==0.13.6' -- docs pyproject.toml Makefile` returns no hits, and `git grep -nF '>=0.12.7' -- docs/local-dev-env.md` returns at least 1.
- [x] [non-codebase] The Gerrit change has `Verified +1`, and its CI run log contains `Successfully installed uv 0.13.6`.
  provenance: environment=github-actions run 41790381719 on Gerrit change 3291; principal=rebar CI (gerrit-verify); privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — the gating CI run on the merged change, read with gh run view --log (16 'Successfully installed uv 0.13.6', 0 manifest fetches)
- [x] [non-codebase] The first Dependabot uv run after the merge logs no `tool_version_not_supported` error.
  provenance: environment=GitHub Dependabot Updates run 41918750684 on navapbc/rebar main (2026-11-04 13:43 PST); principal=dependabot[bot]; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — the scheduled run's own log, read-only with gh run view --log-failed: uv 0.13.5 ran, 0 tool_version_not_supported; its 2 other errors are filed as sublinear-capitate-gavial and eagleeyed-lexical-midge
